title: Verify: deriveStage unit tests
summary: Unit tests for deriveStage mapping and no-regression rule
description: Pure-function tests for deriveStage written from R1's acceptance criteria.

steps.action: Create the test file importing deriveStage from '../src/components/LifecycleStepper' and executionFixture from './fixtures/api' (mirrors execution.Execution JSON in backend/internal/execution/execution.go). Add it.each cases (roundStatus, executionStatus, expected): ('OPEN',undefined,'OPEN'), ('CLOSED','RUNNING','DEVELOPING'), ('CLOSED','AWAITING_APPROVAL','PUBLISHING'), ('CLOSED','APPROVED','PUBLISHING'), ('CLOSED','COMPLETED','COMPLETED'), ('CLOSED','FAILED','CLOSED'), ('CLOSED','QUEUED','CLOSED'), ('PUBLISHING','RUNNING','PUBLISHING'), ('BUILDING','RUNNING','BUILDING'). Add one test calling deriveStage('CLOSED', executionFixture.status) expecting 'DEVELOPING'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/deriveStage.test.ts
